# CGI

> > CGI is a global IT and business consulting services firm delivering technology solutions, digital transformation, and systems integration across media, broadcasting, and enterprise sectors.

CGI provides enterprise technology solutions including OpenMedia for broadcast and newsroom management, with a strong focus on ESG initiatives and corporate social responsibility. The company partners with major organizations like France Télévisions to modernize media infrastructure and supports professional well-being programs.

## Key Topics

- OpenMedia
- France Télévisions
- Newsroom modernization
- Broadcast technology
- Media management
- Digital transformation
- ESG and sustainability
- Mental health and well-being
- EcoVadis
- Carbon Disclosure Project
- Systems integration
- Media diffusion
- Corporate social responsibility
- Technology consulting
